title: Ankhorage Architecture Rules
summary: Provides architecture models, architecture detection, and rules for canonical source graphs.
purpose: Evaluate explicit architecture expectations against source-graph evidence while keeping the generic rules engine domain-neutral.
responsibilities: Define supported architecture models and their semantic roles.
Detect plausible architectures from canonical source-graph evidence.
Evaluate an explicitly selected architecture through the generic rules engine.
boundaries: Does not own source parsing or dependency-graph construction.
Does not select an enforcement target on behalf of a consumer.
Does not add architecture-specific behavior to the domain-neutral rules core.
audience: Architecture auditing tools and maintainers evaluating source-project structure.
Consumers that need architecture detection or explicit architecture-rule evaluation.
useCases: List architecture models understood by the provider.
Detect plausible architecture models from a source graph.
Evaluate a selected architecture and receive evidence-backed findings.

architecture.role: Domain-specific rule provider over canonical dependency graphs and the generic Rules engine.
invariants: Detection and evaluation consume canonical graph evidence.
Detection reports possibilities without silently choosing enforcement policy.
Generic evaluation mechanics remain owned by @ankhorage/rules.
